# Community & Dark Social

`community-and-dark-social` · v1.0.0 · Execute · Growth, Retention & RevOps
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/community-and-dark-social/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Where do our buyers already talk, should we open a community of our own, and is word of mouth growing?

**Inputs:** The communities, people, podcasts and newsletters your customers named when asked where they get advice, with how many named each, how many leads mentioned it, and whether your team is present and answering there; for your own community, the recurring conversation, the host and their hours, the plan for when it goes quiet, and how many people have asked for it; for measurement, two or more periods of coded "How did you hear about us?" answers, branded search impressions, direct sessions to deep pages, and pipeline

**Output:** The map ranked by evidence with every place you should be in and are not, every room you pitched in, and your coverage; a go, not-yet or no on opening your own community with what is missing; and a trend read - working, wrong people, growing, going quiet or flat - across dark share, branded search, deep-page direct traffic and pipeline

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill community-and-dark-social`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/community-and-dark-social/resources/dark-social-read.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/community-and-dark-social/resources/dark-social-read.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- The map holds only the places your customers named. It cannot find rooms nobody mentioned, and its ranking is only as good as the number of customers you asked.
- The trend compares the latest period with the average of the earlier ones and treats a move within 10% as flat. With only two periods, one unusual month sets the verdict.
- It reads coded self-reported answers and counts a person, community, podcast, newsletter or your brand name as dark. Fewer than ten dark answers in a period, or more than 30% uncoded, is too thin to read.
- "Wrong people" (dark signals up, pipeline flat) can be sales-cycle lag. Check the cycle length before concluding the wrong people are talking.

**Review before acting:** The marketing lead checks that "How did you hear about us?" answers were coded the same way in every period, and allows for the sales cycle, before the trend changes spend. The named host confirms their weekly hours before a community opens.
